newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Private firm to promote Morocco's tenders.
newsitem.headline: Private firm to promote Morocco's tenders.

text.p: A Moroccan private group has set up for the first time a consultancy service aimed at helping foreign investors to subscribe to Morocco's international tenders, Morocco's businessmen association said on Wednesday.

The firm called Societe d'Etudes de Realisations de Consultant (SEREC) "will offer efficient services and provide foreign investors with international tenders details to meet their urgent demands on a daily basis", the association said.
The Casablanca-based SEREC firm has a capital of 400,000 dirhams ($45,000), he added.
